dos.text: Attach any "navigate-back" listener directly on the moz-page-header element, handleBack() dispatches a plain non-bubbling Event, so a delegated listener higher up the tree will never catch it.

donts.text: Don't pass a headingLevel outside 1-6, headingTemplate()'s switch silently falls back to rendering an <h2> for anything unrecognized instead of warning.

Don't be surprised when adding or removing description moves the support link, supportLinkTemplate() renders next to the heading only when there's no description, and after the description text otherwise.
